limitations: This packet verifies the obstruction ledger for transition preservation of primitive Hall subspaces.
The compact Hall source packet does not yet supply Hall coproduct matrices, counit maps, primitive kernels, primitive projections, or ambient transition matrices.
The Hall-coproduct transition packet does not yet supply coproduct and counit transition identities.
The core transition-primitive-subspace tables are intentionally empty until kernel rows and zero-defect transition rows are supplied.
It does not prove that transition maps preserve primitive subspaces.
It does not prove lim1 vanishing on primitive spaces.
Primitive-space lim1 vanishing is tracked separately by certificates/hall/primitive_space_lim1_vanishing.
